A '''ravenous ghoul''' appears at [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|CKS}} near the [[mushroom patch]] west of [[Canifis]] when the player is on a [[Slayer/Challenges|Slayer challenge]] assigned by [[Mazchna]] or [[Achtryn]]. For the challenge, the player must be near the ring and must contact Mazchna or Achtryn using an [[enchanted gem]]. The monster will then appear near the ring and attack the player.
